queries_run: Hubbell HUBB market share gaining OR losing 2026
Hubbell new entrant OR displace threat Electrical Equipment & Parts 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 Hubbell 無法精確指出各產品類別的競爭者數量與相對市占，部分對手規模更大、資源更多；未點名新進入者。
findings.excerpt: Hubbell cannot specify with precision the number of competitors in each product category or their relative market position. However, some of its competitors are larger companies with substantial financial and other resources.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：競爭者行為與價格壓力可能使漲價無法完全抵銷成本；AI 等技術採用可能造成長期競爭劣勢。
findings.excerpt: Competitive pricing pressures may not allow us to offset some or all of our increased costs through pricing actions.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 銷售約 +15%、有機約 +10%，管理層稱聚焦交叉銷售與新品搶份額。
findings.excerpt: Management remains focused on capturing additional market share through cross-selling, new product development, and strategic vertical integration, stating, “We are confident in our ability to execute over the second half to deliver on a strong 2026 financial outlook.”

competitive_share_entrants.note: 兩次搜尋未找到第三方份額消長或新進入者的具名來源（僅聚合站粗略資料）；未下第3、4次搜尋。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
